# wreq (vendored)

A vendored, patched copy of the `wreq` HTTP client, used by korvus for its network
transport. See `Cargo.toml` in this crate for the korvus patch notes, and `LICENSE`
for the upstream license and attribution.

Upstream README content (project description, benchmarks, and third-party links)
has been omitted from this vendored copy; refer to the upstream project for it.
